The OCR worker drops the first frame after wake

After the Mac wakes from sleep, the first window read comes back empty. The second read is fine, so the
problem is the warm worker, not the screen.

Steps to reproduce
1. Close the lid for ten minutes.

2. Open it and switch to any window with text.
3. Compare the first two reads in the trace.
Activity
    Ravi Patel2 hours ago
    Seen on two machines. Both were on battery.
